verdict.rationale: Codex supports team distribution via marketplaces (`codex plugin marketplace add`, plugin browser `/plugins`), shared repos (openai/plugins GitHub repo with team-relevant plugin bundles), and files committed to the project (`.agents/skills` scanned up to repo root, per-folder skills for microservices/modules). This directly matches engineering-lead needs for standardizing skills across a team. missing for 10: independent case-study evidence of a team actually rolling this out at scale, and more detail on marketplace governance/permissions for org-wide distribution.
